headline: Committee on Aging reviews financial reports, staff reports, accounting firm engagement, Memory Lane transition, audit schedule, and infection control measures.
summary: The meeting covers approval of reports from the Secretary and Treasurer, staff updates, and ongoing business including an accounting firm engagement and the Memory Lane transition. New business includes a financial audit schedule and additional infection control measures.
items: Vote to accept monthly report of revenues and expenditures for August 2026
Vote to accept the August Program Account Report
September financial reports will be provided for November meeting
Accept September reports as emailed: Executive Director's Report, Program Director's Report, Social Services Report, Memory Lane Report
Other Business: announcements, questions, items to be noted for the record of the meeting
